name: Pak Tak International Limited
summary: Pak Tak International Limited, an investment holding company, engages in supply chain business in Hong Kong and the People's Republic of China. It operates through the Supply Chain Business, Property Investment, Hotel Management and Catering Services, and Iron Ore Mining and Milling segments. The company is involved in the iron ore mining and milling business; and securities investment. It also offers management services; leasing services; trade financing, accounts receivable management, and debt collection services. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
